settings.title: Azure
settings.vscode-azure.pageSize: Number of items to load per page when fetching Azure resources.
settings.vscode-azure.alwaysShowAccountN: Always show account and tenant nodes in the Resources tree view, even when there is only one. By default, these nodes are hidden when there is a single account or tenant, and subscriptions are shown directly at the root.
settings.vscode-azure.groupBy: Controls how resources are grouped under subscriptions in the Resources tree view.
settings.vscode-azure.groupBy.armTag: Group by an ARM tag. Specify the tag name with the 'Group By Tag' setting.
settings.vscode-azure.groupByTag: The ARM tag name to group resources by when 'Group By' is set to 'armTag'.
settings.vscode-azure.signedInTenants: Tenants you signed in to by entering a tenant ID. These are merged into the Resources tree so the tenants remain reachable when listing tenants is blocked (for example by conditional access). Remove entries here to stop showing a tenant.
settings.vscode-azure.selectedSubscripti: The tenants and subscriptions to show in the Azure resources view, as an array of 'tenantId/subscriptionId' strings. When empty, all subscriptions are shown. Use the 'Azure: Select Subscriptions' command to edit this.
Each entry must be in the form 'tenantId/subscriptionId', where both are GUIDs (for example '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111').
